target_entity_scope: entities (existing, not proposed) that are the source or target of non-preserve steps
graph_c_scope: all steps; node type = (operation, relation); edges = consecutive step pairs typed by their node types
polarity_scope: per shared relation type among non-preserve steps: 0 if the two operation sets are identical; else mean pairwise cost over the operations unique to each side (or the 'other' cost when only one side has unique operations); then mean over shared types
